j.desc: One ordinary grown man who stops to listen to nine-year-old Manny’s trash-can rhythm in Bronx street memory. Afro-Latino man in his forties, deep warm brown skin, sturdy everyday build, short dark hair with slight gray at temples, neat mustache, receptive surprised half-smile. Plain faded olive work jacket over cream shirt, loose dark trousers and worn brown work shoes. Full-body three-quarter stance halted mid-walk, head turned toward off-screen musician, both hands freely visible. No headphones, instruments, trash can, text or logos.
